entry.summary:
Associate professor of midwifery and lead maternity care midwife Robyn Maude has 46 years of experience. 

She talks about the partnership model used in Aotearoa New Zealand, which is based on trust and reciprocity, building relationships and having informed choice and consent. 

Robyn says you need to ask people you’re working with right from day one, ‘What are the things you need to keep you culturally safe during your pregnancy?’

Go to www.hqsc.govt.nz/AotearoaPatientSafetyDay2024 for the accessible transcript and to find more resources for Te Rā Haumaru Tūroro o Aotearoa | Aotearoa Patient Safety Day 2024.
